title: HomeGuard Account Standing and the LandlordGuard Returned-Payment Fee
content:
**Rule.** The household standing adjustment on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy returned-payment fee looks at the named insured's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy account: a HomeGuard policy in force with no returned payment posted on it in the 12 calendar months up to the charge date takes 5.00 USD off; a HomeGuard policy in force with one or more returned payments posted on it in those months adds 5.00 USD; no HomeGuard policy in force changes nothing.

The household standing adjustment is included in the returned-fee adjustment, as a deduction or an addition.

| HomeGuard Homeowners Policy in force | Returned payments on the HomeGuard account, 12 calendar months up to the charge date | Household standing adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 5.00 USD off |
| yes | one or more | 5.00 USD added |
| no | — | no change |

## Records read

- Whether the named insured holds a HomeGuard policy whose status is in force.
- The returned-payment entries on the named insured's HomeGuard premium account, each placed in the window by the date it was posted.

## Hypothetical households

- HomeGuard policy in force, its account clean for the past year: 5.00 USD off.
- HomeGuard policy in force, a returned payment on it 4 months ago: 5.00 USD added.
- HomeGuard policy cancelled two years ago: no change.
